title: God Items
description: In game this mod adds god items to very speacial ability
body:
⚔️ GodItems
GodItems adds two powerful legendary weapons to Minecraft — the God Spear and the God Mace — along with a Player Head item and admin commands for server management.

🗡️ God Spear
A legendary spear with devastating power and mobility.
Abilities:

Dash Attack: Shift + Left Click to launch yourself forward at high speed
15 second cooldown
Does not consume hunger while held

Enchantments:

Sharpness X
Lunge V
Fire Aspect II
Knockback II
Mending
Unbreakable

Crafting Recipe
![Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fb71709070fb62fa39960970bc0332a98387eb4e.png):


🔨 God Mace
A legendary mace that extends the vanilla Mace with godlike power.
Abilities:

Smash Attack: Deals massive fall-damage bonus on enemies

Dash Attack: Shift + Right Click to dash forward
20 second cooldown

Enchantments:

Breach V
Density V
Wind Burst III
Mending
Unbreakable

Crafting Recipe
![Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/97e2252de9c6a7b1b581dcacd13600d02f3d17b6.png)


💀 Player Head
A Steve head item added to the GodWeapons creative tab.

Used as a crafting ingredient for both God Spear and God Mace
Dropped by players on death (100% drop chance)


🛡️ Admin Commands
/godweapons setgearOpens a 45-slot chest menu to set gear for spawned mobs
/godweapons spawn <mob> <count>
  Spawns fully equipped mobs at your location

📦 Requirements

Minecraft 26.1.2
Fabric Loader
Fabric API


⚠️ Notes

Each weapon can only be crafted once per player (one-time craft limit)
Recipes are visible in the recipe book
